tutorial.title: Tutorial: a todo app
tutorial.lead: Build a small todo application in five steps. Each step adds one concept, and each example is the complete, working code of that step: compare the files of two consecutive steps to see exactly what changed.

step1AStatic.title: Step 1 — A static component
step1AStatic.p1: Every component starts as a class decorated with @WebComponent, pointing at its template and its stylesheet. The template is plain HTML for now.

step2StateIn.title: Step 2 — State in a signal
step2StateIn.p1: The todos move into a signal. The template renders them with @for, and shows their number with an interpolation. track todo.id tells @for how to recognise a todo across changes, so that its DOM can be reused.

step3AddingTodos.title: Step 3 — Adding todos
step3AddingTodos.p1: The (submit) listener calls add($event), which reads the form, appends a todo and resets the form. The update produces a new array: signals compare values by identity, so pushing into the existing array would notify nobody.

step4CompletingAnd.title: Step 4 — Completing and removing
step4CompletingAnd.p1: Each row gets a checkbox and a remove button. A conditional binding, @if (todo.done) { checked } written inside the tag, adds the checked attribute only to the done todos. A computed signal counts the remaining todos, and @if shows a message when the list is empty.

callout1.heading: Why track todo instead of todo.id?
callout1.body: Toggling a todo replaces it with a new object that has the same id. @for reuses the row of a key it already knows, and the row keeps showing the object it was created with: tracked by todo.id, a toggled todo would not be redrawn. Tracking by the object itself renders a new row for the new object. See Lists with @for.

step5AChild.title: Step 5 — A child component and a filter
step5AChild.p1: The row moves into its own component, ex-todo-item. It receives the todo through a required input and reports what happens through two outputs, doneChange and removed. The parent keeps the state and adds a filter: a signal, a computed list of the visible todos, and a @switch for the footer.

callout1.heading: Why todo()?.title instead of todo().title?
callout1.body: A child component is rendered as soon as it is inserted in the page, and the parent binds its inputs right after. During that first render todo() is still undefined, even though the input is required: reading todo().title would throw, and stop the rest of the child template from rendering. Optional chaining keeps the first render safe; the bindings update as soon as the input is set. See Inputs with @Property.

whereToGoFrom.title: Where to go from here
whereToGoFrom.p1: The guides cover each concept in depth, with their edge cases: start from signals, inputs and lists.

api.WebComponent: Defines a class extending CustomElement as a custom element, with its compiled template and its stylesheet. The options must be string literals.
api.Property: Declares an input. The accessor holds an InputSignal, set by the bindings of the parent template.
api.Property.required: Declares an input that every use of the component must bind, in every branch of a conditional binding. Checked at compile time.
api.Event: Declares an output. emit(detail?, options?) dispatches a CustomEvent named after the accessor on the host element.
api.Query: The first element of the shadow root matching a selector or a component class, kept up to date as a signal.
api.Query.all: Every element of the shadow root matching a selector or a component class.
api.Query.content: The first element projected into the slots of the component that matches a selector or a component class.
api.Query.content.all: Every projected element matching a selector or a component class, in the order of the slots.
api.Directive: Registers a class extending CustomDirective or StructuralDirective under a selector, used as @@selector or *selector.
api.CustomElement: Base class of components: an open shadow root, the lifecycle hooks, and effects disposed at disconnection.
api.CustomDirective: Base class of the directives acting on the element they are applied to.
api.StructuralDirective: Base class of the directives deciding whether the element they are applied to is rendered.
api.query: The function form of @Query, for a field initializer. It must be created before the component is connected.
api.Output: The type of an @Event accessor. Without a type argument the event carries no detail, and templates cannot read $event.
api.EventOptions: The options of an output, given to @Event or to a single emit. At least one key is required.
api._Context, _if, _for, _switch, _renderEle: The runtime of the compiled templates, and its types (BindingHost, RenderElementAttribute, …). They are exported for the generated code, not for applications.
api.signal: A writable signal: read it by calling it, write it with set or update.
api.computed: A signal derived from others, evaluated lazily and cached until a dependency changes.
api.effect: Runs a function now, and again in a microtask after the signals it read change. Returns the function disposing it.
api.untracked: Runs a function without tracking the signals it reads.
api.input: Creates the InputSignal held by a @Property accessor. Applications use the decorator instead.
api.Signal: The type returned by signal(). Annotating a member with it makes the attributes reading the member reactive.
api.InputSignal: The type of an input: read-only for the component, set by the bindings of the parent.
api.QuerySignal: The type of a query: a read-only signal updated a microtask after the DOM changes.
api.EffectOptions: Hooks of an effect. onCleanup runs once, when the effect is disposed.
api.InputSignalOptions: The options of input(), and of @Property together with alias.
api.QueryTarget, QueryElement, QuerySlotOpti: The target of a query, the element type it resolves to, and the options of the content queries.
api.createQuerySignal, createSlotQuerySignal: Used by the query decorators and functions to build their signals.
api.loadSignals: Installs the global Signal polyfill. It must run before @xaendar/core is loaded, from a module of its own.
api.SignalOptions: The options of signal() and of Signal.State. computed() only uses equals.
api.SignalEqual, ExtractSignalType: The type of an equality function, and the type of the value of a signal.
api.Signal.State, Signal.Computed: The classes of the TC39 proposal, installed globally by loadSignals. signal() and computed() wrap them.
api.Signal.subtle: The low-level API of the proposal: watchers, introspection, and the symbols of the watched and unwatched callbacks.

[Lexer] Unknown flow-control keyword.cause: An @ in text starts a block: a keyword written without a space before its parenthesis (@if(…)), a keyword that does not exist (@unless, @empty), or a plain @, as in an email address.
[Lexer] Unknown flow-control keyword.fix: Write a space after the keyword, and an interpolation such as { '@' } for a literal @.

[Lexer] Unexpected character 'p' after '.cause: A literal < in text, as in 1 < 2, is read as the start of a tag.

[Lexer] Attribute value must start with.cause: An attribute value in single quotes, or without quotes.
[Lexer] Attribute value must start with.fix: Use double quotes for every attribute value.

[Lexer] Event must be included in Double.cause: A listener with a nested call or an expression as argument, such as go(n()) or go(n() + 1), or with two statements.
[Lexer] Event must be included in Double.fix: Call a single method, with literals, members, loop variables, property accesses or $event as arguments, and compute the rest in the method.

[Lexer] Event handler cannot be empty.cause: An arrow function as listener, such as (click)="() => go()".

[Lexer] No spaces are allowed in event h.cause: An assignment as listener, such as (click)="open = true".
[Lexer] No spaces are allowed in event h.fix: Move the assignment into a method.

[Lexer] Expected { after @import.fix: Use a named import: @import { Card } from …

[Lexer] Directives cannot be declared in.cause: A directive written inside the parentheses of another one.
[Lexer] Directives cannot be declared in.fix: Write the directives one after the other on the tag.

[Lexer] The properties of a structural d.cause: An @if or @switch inside the parentheses of a structural directive.
[Lexer] The properties of a structural d.fix: Apply the whole directive inside the condition, once per branch.

[Lexer] Structural directives cannot lis.cause: A listener inside the parentheses of a structural directive.
[Lexer] Structural directives cannot lis.fix: Write the listener on the tag, outside the directive.

[Parser] Expected closing tag input whil.cause: An element never closed: a void element without />, an unclosed template literal, an interpolation such as { '{' }, or an expression starting with a backtick after a space.
[Parser] Expected closing tag input whil.fix: Self-close void elements (<input />), use { '\x7B' } for a brace, and write a template literal right after the brace.

[Parser] Expected closing tag div, found.cause: A closing tag written with a different case.
[Parser] Expected closing tag div, found.fix: Write opening and closing tags the same way.

[Parser] No transition function for toke.fix: Put the @else right after the closing brace of the @if.

[Parser] Attribute value missing for hid.cause: A valueless attribute right before a structural directive, or an attribute bound to an expression starting with a backtick after a space.
[Parser] Attribute value missing for hid.fix: Move the attribute after the directive, or give it an empty value; write the backtick right after the brace.

[Parser] Attribute \"title\" is bound mo.cause: The same attribute written both outside and inside a conditional binding.
[Parser] Attribute \"title\" is bound mo.fix: Bind it only inside the condition, in every branch that needs it.

[Parser] Directive \"exTint\" is applied.cause: The same directive applied twice to one element.
[Parser] Directive \"exTint\" is applied.fix: Apply it once; switch its inputs with a condition if needed.

[Parser] 'user(); as u' must be a single.cause: More than one expression where one is expected, as in @if (x; as y) or a; b.
[Parser] 'user(); as u' must be a single.fix: Write a single expression; read the value again inside the block.

[Parser] 'FirstAssignment' is not allowe.cause: A construct forbidden in expressions. The same message names the others: 'new', function expressions, 'ThisKeyword', 'AsExpression', 'RegularExpressionLiteral', 'CommaToken'.
[Parser] 'FirstAssignment' is not allowe.fix: Move the logic into a method or a computed signal of the class.

[Parser] 'let i' is not a valid alias id.cause: An alias of @for written with let.

[TypeChecker] foreign-thing selector is.cause: A tag with a dash that is not a Xaendar component imported by the template: a missing @import, or a custom element of another library.
[TypeChecker] foreign-thing selector is.fix: Import the component; create elements of other libraries in code.

[TypeChecker] @@exTint selector is not a.fix: Import the directive class in the template.

[TypeChecker] Required property \"name\".cause: A required input bound only in some branches.
[TypeChecker] Required property \"name\".fix: Add an @else or @default branch binding it, or bind it outside the condition.

[TypeChecker] Unknown event \"valuechang.cause: A listener for an event the component does not declare: a different case, or a native event such as click on a component tag.
[TypeChecker] Unknown event \"valuechang.fix: Match the name of the accessor; listen to native events on a wrapper element.

[TypeChecker] Unknown property \"shade\".cause: An input the directive does not declare.
[TypeChecker] Unknown property \"shade\".fix: Use the name of a @Property of the directive.

Property 'bubbly' does not exist on type.cause: A listener for an unknown event on a native element.
Property 'bubbly' does not exist on type.fix: Listen to custom events on the component emitting them, or on a component re-emitting them.

Type 'string' does not satisfy the expec.cause: A static value, always a string, bound to an input of another type.

Cannot find name '$event'. Did you mean.cause: $event used for an output without a type argument, or as $event.target.
Cannot find name '$event'. Did you mean.fix: Give the output a type, such as Output<string>; pass $event whole and read the target in the method.

Property 'secret' is private and only ac.cause: A private or protected member read by the template.

Property 'LIMIT' does not exist on type.cause: A module constant read by the template, which only sees the members of the class.
Property 'LIMIT' does not exist on type.fix: Expose it as a member: readonly limit = LIMIT.

This comparison appears to be unintentio.cause: A readonly member initialized with a literal has a literal type, and the template is checked with it.
This comparison appears to be unintentio.fix: Annotate the member with a wider type.

Argument of type 'Set<number>' is not as.cause: @for over something that is neither an array nor a number: a Set, a Map, a string.
Argument of type 'Set<number>' is not as.fix: Convert it to an array, for instance in a computed signal.

'this' implicitly has type 'any' because.cause: A track expression reading a member of the component.
'this' implicitly has type 'any' because.fix: Track by a field of the item, or by the item itself.

Property '$count' does not exist on type.cause: $count is not one of the variables of @for.
Property '$count' does not exist on type.fix: Read the length of the list.

Cannot find name 'first'..cause: A member of the component as the value of an @case, which only accepts literals.

'root.prices.coffee' is possibly 'undefi.cause: The strict options of tsconfig.json, such as noUncheckedIndexedAccess, apply to templates too.
'root.prices.coffee' is possibly 'undefi.fix: Use ?. or ??, or a precise type.

[Generator] Signal field \"step\" is alr.cause: A signal member declared both by a class and by the class it extends.
[Generator] Signal field \"step\" is alr.fix: Declare it once; in the base class, type it as a function.

Invalid custom element name \"laberr\" i.cause: A selector that is not a valid custom element name.
Invalid custom element name \"laberr\" i.fix: Use lowercase letters and at least one dash.

Selector \"x-card\" of component \"A\" -.cause: Two components with the same selector.

Selector \"exTint\" of directive \"A\" -.cause: Two directives with the same selector.
Selector \"exTint\" of directive \"A\" -.fix: Rename one of them, ideally with a prefix.

Could not find template at <path>.cause: A templateUrl pointing to a missing file.
Could not find template at <path>.fix: Fix the path, relative to the file of the component.

Unsupported stylesheet extension \".scss.cause: A styleUrl that is not a .css file.

Could not find the static initializer bl.cause: The decorators were not compiled before the Xaendar plugin ran.
Could not find the static initializer bl.fix: Put the Babel plugin before xaendarPlugin().

Error: Unable to resolve module path for.cause: An @import whose path does not resolve: only relative paths to files or folders are supported.
Error: Unable to resolve module path for.fix: Use a relative path; packages and tsconfig aliases are not resolved.

Class \"Callout\" was not found in the i.cause: An @import naming a class the file does not declare, or a type.
Class \"Callout\" was not found in the i.fix: Import the component or directive class by its exact name.

Unterminated string constant.cause: Reported by Babel on the generated code for an interpolation such as { '}' }: the brace inside the string ends the interpolation.

XCard does not seems to have a Render Fu.cause: The template of the component did not compile, its templateUrl is not a string literal, its file does not end with .xd.component.ts, or the class is a subclass without its own @WebComponent.
XCard does not seems to have a Render Fu.fix: Look for the compiler message printed before it.

ReferenceError: Signal is not defined.cause: loadSignals() did not run before @xaendar/core was loaded.
ReferenceError: Signal is not defined.fix: Call it in a module loaded before the application.

Error: No directive registered for selec.cause: The template imports the directive, but its module was never loaded at runtime.
Error: No directive registered for selec.fix: Import the module, for instance with the glob of main.ts.

Error: Directive TintDirective registere.cause: A custom directive applied with *, or a structural one with @@.
Error: Directive TintDirective registere.fix: Use @@ for CustomDirective and * for StructuralDirective.

Error: Selector \"exTint\" is already us.cause: Two directive classes registered with the same selector.

TypeError: Cannot read properties of und.cause: this.effect called in the constructor of a directive, before its context exists.
A listener calling a method of a member, such as (click)="helper.run()": it compiles, and fails at the click.
TypeError: Cannot read properties of und.fix: Call a method of the component, which calls the helper.

TypeError: stop is not a function.cause: A query created with query() after the component was connected, thrown at the next disconnection.

ReferenceError: DEFAULT_LEVEL is not def.cause: An input whose default is not a literal, bound conditionally by a parent: the default is copied into the code of the parent.
ReferenceError: DEFAULT_LEVEL is not def.fix: Write the default as a literal.

NotSupportedError: Failed to execute 'de.cause: Two classes defined with the same selector at runtime.

NotSupportedError: Failed to execute 'at.cause: attachShadow called by a component, which already has an open shadow root.

@import rules are not allowed here..cause: A browser warning: a component stylesheet is a constructed stylesheet, which drops @import rules.
@import rules are not allowed here..fix: Put every rule in the CSS file of the component.

Circular dependency detected while compu.cause: A computed signal reading itself, directly or through others.
Circular dependency detected while compu.fix: Break the cycle with a writable signal.

Cannot set value while signals are froze.cause: A signal written, or read (Cannot get value…), inside watched, unwatched or Watcher.notify.

Cannot unwatch a signal that is not bein.cause: The disposer of a standalone effect called twice.

TypeError: signal.getSinks is not a func.cause: Signal.subtle.introspectSinks given the function returned by signal() or computed().
TypeError: signal.getSinks is not a func.fix: Use Signal.State and Signal.Computed for introspection.

error: unknown command 'generate'.cause: The component command is registered at the top level.
error: unknown command 'generate'.fix: Run xd component <name>, or xd c <name>.

Tag <Widget> is not a valid custom eleme.cause: A component name, or a project name followed by -root, that is not a valid custom element name.
Tag <Widget> is not a valid custom eleme.fix: Use lowercase letters and a dash.

Tag <font-face> is a reserved tag name a.cause: One of the names reserved by the HTML specification.

✖ Directory \"user-card\" already exist.cause: xd component would overwrite an existing folder.
✖ Directory \"user-card\" already exist.fix: Pick another name, or add --force to replace it.

✖ Invalid style option: sass.cause: xd new accepts css, scss, less and styl.
✖ Invalid style option: sass.fix: Use css: it is the only extension the plugin compiles.

a-signal-declared-again-in-a.title: A signal declared again in a subclass breaks the template
a-signal-declared-again-in-a.details: The signal is listed twice: [Generator] Signal field "x" is already declared in this scope. Unlike other template errors, it stops xd build.
a-signal-declared-again-in-a.workaround: In the base class, type the member as a function.

a-non-literal-default-is-copied.title: A non-literal default is copied into the parent
a-non-literal-default-is-copied.details: When a parent binds an input conditionally, the default written in @Property is pasted into the code of the parent, where the names it uses are undefined: ReferenceError at render.

a-listener-calling-a-method-of.title: A listener calling a method of a member fails at runtime
a-listener-calling-a-method-of.details: (click)="helper.run()" compiles, then throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'bind') at the click.
a-listener-calling-a-method-of.workaround: Call a method of the component.

an-expression-starting-with-a-backtick.title: An expression starting with a backtick after a space
an-expression-starting-with-a-backtick.details: { `text` } in text or in an attribute is not parsed: Expected closing tag, or Attribute value missing.
an-expression-starting-with-a-backtick.workaround: Write the backtick right after the brace, or start with another operand.

braces-inside-strings-of-an-interpolatio.title: Braces inside strings of an interpolation
braces-inside-strings-of-an-interpolatio.details: The braces are counted even inside strings: { '}' } produces invalid code (Unterminated string constant), { '{' } an unclosed element.
braces-inside-strings-of-an-interpolatio.workaround: Use { '\x7B' } and { '\x7D' }; balanced braces are fine.

nested-template-literals.title: Nested template literals
nested-template-literals.details: A template literal inside another one is rejected as more than one expression, with a duplicated backtick in the message.
nested-template-literals.workaround: Build the inner string in a method.

an-unclosed-comment-truncates-the-templa.title: An unclosed comment truncates the template silently
an-unclosed-comment-truncates-the-templa.details: Everything after <!-- without --> disappears, with no error.

a-valueless-attribute-before-a-structura.title: A valueless attribute before a structural directive
a-valueless-attribute-before-a-structura.details: <span hidden *dir(…)> fails with Attribute value missing for hidden.
a-valueless-attribute-before-a-structura.workaround: Write the attribute after the directive, or as hidden="".

html-inside-foreignobject-is-created-as.title: HTML inside foreignObject is created as SVG
html-inside-foreignobject-is-created-as.details: The children of <foreignObject> stay in the SVG namespace, so the browser does not render them as HTML.
html-inside-foreignobject-is-created-as.workaround: Position HTML over the SVG with CSS, or create it in code.

a-space-between-two-interpolations-disap.title: A space between two interpolations disappears
a-space-between-two-interpolations-disap.details: { first } { second } renders the two values joined.
a-space-between-two-interpolations-disap.workaround: Write {`${first} ${second}`}, or put other text between them.

a-shorthand-object-in-an-interpolation.title: A shorthand object in an interpolation renders nothing
a-shorthand-object-in-an-interpolation.details: { {b} } compiles, and renders an empty text.
a-shorthand-object-in-an-interpolation.workaround: Write the object in full, or format it in a method.

newlines-are-removed-and-entities-are.title: Newlines are removed and entities are not decoded
newlines-are-removed-and-entities-are.details: A line break in text joins the words around it, and < is shown as written. Text cannot contain a literal @, { or <.
newlines-are-removed-and-entities-are.workaround: Indent wrapped lines, and use interpolations such as { '@' } and Unicode characters.

signal-members-are-detected-by-syntax.title: Signal members are detected by syntax
signal-members-are-detected-by-syntax.details: An attribute is reactive only if it names a member initialized by a function of @xaendar/core/signals, or annotated with one of its types. A module signal assigned to an unannotated member, or a member initialized by another function such as queryAll, is read once.
signal-members-are-detected-by-syntax.workaround: Annotate the member with Signal<T> or Computed<T>, or wrap it in computed().

a-method-reading-signals-is-evaluated.title: A method reading signals is evaluated once in an attribute
a-method-reading-signals-is-evaluated.details: In text, any expression is reactive; in an attribute, only one naming a signal member.
a-method-reading-signals-is-evaluated.workaround: Turn the method into a computed signal.

members-named-history-or-location.title: Members named history or location
members-named-history-or-location.details: In a template, these names resolve to the globals of the browser, even when the component declares them.

output-without-a-type-no-event.title: Output without a type: no $event
output-without-a-type-no-event.details: The listener of an Output with no type argument cannot use $event, so it cannot cancel or inspect the event.
output-without-a-type-no-event.workaround: Give the output a type, even a simple one.

every-tag-with-a-dash-must.title: Every tag with a dash must be an imported Xaendar component
every-tag-with-a-dash-must.details: Custom elements of other libraries are rejected by the type checker, and so are native events on the tag of a component.
every-tag-with-a-dash-must.workaround: Create foreign elements in code; listen to native events on a wrapper.

a-child-is-rendered-before-the.title: A child is rendered before the bindings of its parent
a-child-is-rendered-before-the.details: In onInit, and in the first render, inputs hold their defaults and required ones are undefined. An exception in the first run of a binding stops the rest of the template of the child for good. Events emitted in onInit or afterRender are lost.
a-child-is-rendered-before-the.workaround: Read inputs reactively, use ?. on required ones, and emit after a microtask.

rows-of-for-keep-the-item.title: Rows of @for keep the item they were created with
rows-of-for-keep-the-item.details: A new object with the same key does not update its row, and track $index shows stale rows when items are prepended. Duplicate keys corrupt the list.
rows-of-for-keep-the-item.workaround: Track by identity, or keep the changing fields in signals; use unique keys.

switch-evaluates-its-expression-once-per.title: @switch evaluates its expression once per case
switch-evaluates-its-expression-once-per.details: The expression runs again for each @case until one matches: side effects and costly calls are repeated.
switch-evaluates-its-expression-once-per.workaround: Switch over a signal or a computed signal.

a-query-created-after-the-connection.title: A query created after the connection
a-query-created-after-the-connection.details: query() called after the component is connected stays null until the next connection, and the next disconnection throws TypeError: stop is not a function, skipping the other hooks.

an-effect-created-in-the-constructor.title: An effect created in the constructor dies at the first disconnection
an-effect-created-in-the-constructor.details: Effects created in field initializers or in the constructor are disposed when the component is disconnected, and never created again.
an-effect-created-in-the-constructor.workaround: Create effects in onInit or afterRender.

a-detail-with-option-keys-is.title: A detail with option keys is taken for options
a-detail-with-option-keys-is.details: emit({ bubbles: true, value: 1 }) dispatches an event with a null detail, and bubbles set to true.
a-detail-with-option-keys-is.workaround: Wrap the detail in another object.

input-deletes-the-transform-of-its.title: input() deletes the transform of its options
input-deletes-the-transform-of-its.details: The options object passed to input() loses its transform: reused for a second input, it applies none. @Property is not affected, since it builds a new object each time.
input-deletes-the-transform-of-its.workaround: Pass a new options object to each call.

untracked-does-not-survive-a-computed.title: untracked does not survive a computed evaluated inside it
untracked-does-not-survive-a-computed.details: After a computed signal is evaluated inside untracked, the following reads are tracked again by the outer effect.

an-unwatched-computed-signal-is-evaluate.title: An unwatched computed signal is evaluated at every read
an-unwatched-computed-signal-is-evaluate.details: Without an effect or a watcher depending on it, the cache of a computed signal is not used.
an-unwatched-computed-signal-is-evaluate.workaround: Read costly computed signals from effects or templates.

watched-and-unwatched-fire-on-every.title: watched and unwatched fire on every run of the only dependent
watched-and-unwatched-fire-on-every.details: The sinks are removed before each recomputation, so a signal with one dependent is unwatched and watched again every time it runs. computed() ignores both callbacks.
watched-and-unwatched-fire-on-every.workaround: Make the callbacks idempotent; use Signal.Computed for computed ones.

signal-and-computed-are-not-instances.title: signal() and computed() are not instances of the proposal classes
signal-and-computed-are-not-instances.details: They return wrapper functions: instanceof Signal.State is false, and Signal.subtle.introspectSinks throws signal.getSinks is not a function.
signal-and-computed-are-not-instances.workaround: Use Signal.State and Signal.Computed for introspection.

template-errors-do-not-fail-the.title: Template errors do not fail the build
template-errors-do-not-fail-the.details: xd build exits with 0, and the component reaches the bundle without a render function.
template-errors-do-not-fail-the.workaround: Fail the pipeline on the Xaendar: messages.

classes-are-not-type-checked.title: Classes are not type-checked
classes-are-not-type-checked.details: Only templates are checked: members clashing with HTMLElement, such as title, lang, remove or matches, go unnoticed.

the-dev-server-keeps-stale-metadata.title: The dev server keeps stale metadata
the-dev-server-keeps-stale-metadata.details: After changing the type of an input or output, the templates using it are still checked against the old one, and a page created before its template stays without a render function, until the server restarts.

the-dev-overlay-reports-handled-errors.title: The dev overlay reports handled errors
the-dev-overlay-reports-handled-errors.details: Vite prints [Unhandled error] even for errors handled with preventDefault on window.
the-dev-overlay-reports-handled-errors.workaround: None: it happens in development only.

xd-generate-does-not-exist.title: xd generate does not exist
xd-generate-does-not-exist.details: The component command is registered at the top level instead of inside generate.
xd-generate-does-not-exist.workaround: Run xd component, or xd c.

style-options-the-plugin-cannot-compile.title: Style options the plugin cannot compile
style-options-the-plugin-cannot-compile.details: xd new accepts scss, less and styl, which the plugin rejects; xd component ignores xaendar.json and always writes CSS.

the-project-name-is-checked-too.title: The project name is checked too late
the-project-name-is-checked-too.details: xd new MyApp writes most of the project before rejecting MyApp-root, and never installs the dependencies.
the-project-name-is-checked-too.workaround: Use a lowercase name with a dash, and delete the half-made folder.

the-generated-spec-does-not-run.title: The generated spec does not run
the-generated-spec-does-not-run.details: npm test runs Vitest without the decorators transform: SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token.
the-generated-spec-does-not-run.workaround: Configure Vitest with the same plugins and a DOM environment.

the-published-packages-predate-this-docu.title: The published packages predate this documentation
the-published-packages-predate-this-docu.details: The 0.12.0 packages on npm export BaseWebComponent, not CustomElement: a project generated by a CLI built from the repository fails with MISSING_EXPORT.
the-published-packages-predate-this-docu.workaround: Work inside the repository until the next release.

the-language-server-never-compiles-a.title: The language server never compiles a template
the-language-server-never-compiles-a.details: The index mapping templates to components is never filled, so diagnostics and completions are never produced. Hover is announced but not implemented.
the-language-server-never-compiles-a.workaround: Read the errors in the terminal of xd start.

the-grammar-highlights-instead-of.title: The grammar highlights {{ }} instead of { }
the-grammar-highlights-instead-of.details: Interpolations and directives keep the colors of plain HTML.

documentation-inside-the-packages-is-out.title: Documentation inside the packages is out of date
documentation-inside-the-packages-is-out.details: The README of core mentions attributeChangedCallback, InputSignal<a, b> and .get(); the README of signals imports effect from @xaendar/signals and says that two synchronous sets run an effect twice; the JSDoc of onCleanup says it runs before each re-run; the JSDoc of signal() defaults to any; QuerySlotOptions mentions slot; the @for alias is documented as $index = i.
documentation-inside-the-packages-is-out.workaround: Trust this site: every behavior here was observed.
